notes.title: Update to version 0.2.6
notes.content:
Changelist (version 0.2.6):
[list]
[*] Adjusting waves on enemies.
[*] Adding info about game type to save slots.
[*] Fixing bug with moonlight intensity. 
[*] Fixing saving map on lava level.
[*] Increased scroll speed in main menu windows.  
[*] Fixing electric airstrike recipe.   
[*] Fixing bug with gnome award in endless mode
[/list]

notes.title: Burning Update is available now!
notes.content:
List of new Features:
[list]
[*] New Map - Floor is lava, standing on ground deals you damage, so use your cardboards to build paths and bridges. 
[*] New Weapon - Magma gun, which shoots burning lava clods.
[*] New Building Part - Fire Plate Trap which sets up on fire enemy whose stand on it. 
[*] New Enemy - Fire Boss, large enemy with flame throwers.
[/list]

List of fixes:
[list]
[*] Faster production of weapon parts and ammunition.
[*] Fixing Firework recipe.
[*] Changes in number of spawned enemies. 
[*] Minor UI fixes.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=I8UhE1yzNEU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.content:
